gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the data policy for my project to ensure compliance with data protection regulations.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current data policy details, including the policy ID, description, and any applicable rules.

gold.user: As a compliance officer, I need to access all data policies associated with different projects to assess their adherence to legal standards.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all data policies linked to projects, including project IDs, policy descriptions, and status.
